listening_turns.text: like a chocolate bar or maybe chewing gum,

listening_turns.speaker: Oliver
listening_turns.text: and these are placed at the checkout for last minute impulse buys:

listening_turns.speaker: Oliver
listening_turns.text: little small items that don't seem like much,

listening_turns.speaker: Oliver
listening_turns.text: which you're probably, potentially, going to add on to your purchase.

listening_turns.speaker: Oliver
listening_turns.text: And the best rule, I think, is to use the 72 hour rule.
listening_turns.fa: و فکر می‌کنم بهترین قانون اینه که از قانون ۷۲ ساعته استفاده کنی.

listening_turns.speaker: Oliver
listening_turns.text: And what it means is, whenever you feel a very strong impulse to buy something that
listening_turns.fa: و منظورش اینه که هر وقت یه تمایل خیلی قوی به خرید یه چیز غیرضروری داشتی، یعنی چیزی که واقعاً بهش نیاز نداری، به خودت ۷۲ ساعت، یعنی سه روز، مهلت بده و صبر کن.

listening_turns.speaker: Oliver
listening_turns.text: is non-essential, so something that you don't really need,

listening_turns.speaker: Oliver
listening_turns.text: give yourself 72 hours, so three days, and wait.

listening_turns.speaker: Oliver
listening_turns.text: Add it to your cart, maybe.
listening_turns.fa: شاید بذاریش تو سبد خریدت.

listening_turns.speaker: Oliver
listening_turns.text: you know, You can wait a little bit and see after three days if you still
listening_turns.fa: می‌تونی یه کم صبر کنی و بعد از سه روز ببینی که آیا هنوز می‌خوای بخریش یا نه.

listening_turns.speaker: Oliver
listening_turns.text: want to purchase it.

listening_turns.speaker: Oliver
listening_turns.text: In many cases, that dopamine rush, that feeling that you're getting when you're going to buy
listening_turns.fa: توی خیلی از موارد، اون موج دوپامین، اون حسی که موقع خرید گرفتن داری، از بین میره و این باعث میشه به این نتیجه برسی که واقعاً بهش نیاز نداری.

listening_turns.speaker: Oliver
listening_turns.text: it, will disappear, and that will give you the feeling that you actually need.

listening_turns.text: You know, Do you still want it?

listening_turns.text: Do you still think you need it?

listening_turns.speaker: Oliver
listening_turns.text: So giving yourself that period of 72 hours is a great way to do this.
listening_turns.fa: پس دادن به خودت اون ۷۲ ساعت، یه راه عالی برای این کاره.

listening_turns.speaker: Oliver
listening_turns.text: Buying things isn't inherently bad.

listening_turns.text: It's not bad itself, right?

listening_turns.speaker: Oliver
listening_turns.text: But when we buy for that emotion, for dopamine,
listening_turns.fa: ولی وقتی برای اون هیجان، برای دوپامین خرید می‌کنیم، معمولاً بعد از اون لحظه اول پشیمون می‌شیم.

listening_turns.speaker: Oliver
listening_turns.text: often we will regret it after that initial impulse.

listening_turns.text: And to make it worse, these companies are trying to manipulate us.

listening_turns.text: They are actively trying to get you to spend more money.

listening_turns.text: So by taking some steps and recognizing this,

listening_turns.speaker: Oliver
listening_turns.text: we can minimize that manipulation and have more control over our purchases.
